title: Boethiah's Calling
description: A Daedric quest requiring the Dragonborn to find the Sacellum of Boethiah, sacrifice a trusted follower on the Pillar of Sacrifice, slay the remaining cultists, then kill Boethiah's current champion at Knifepoint Ridge to claim the Ebony Mail and become her new champion.

base_facts: I serve Boethiah at the Sacellum in the mountains near Windhelm.
To earn Boethiah's favor, you must sacrifice someone who trusts you on the Pillar of Sacrifice.
Take the Blade of Sacrifice and lead a follower to the pillar.

SACRIFICE_FOLLOWER: A sacrifice has been offered to Boethiah. She will speak through the fallen.
SLAY_CULTISTS: The cultists have fallen. Boethiah will name her new champion from whoever remains.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Boethiah has named a new champion after the trials of sacrifice and combat were fulfilled.
The Sacellum's purpose is served; I remain here to test the next who seeks Boethiah's calling.
The Blade of Sacrifice I provided was used as intended, and Boethiah's favor has been earned.

base_facts: I am Boethiah, Daedric Prince of Deceit, Conspiracy, and Treachery.
I demand proof of devotion through sacrifice and combat.

SLAY_CULTISTS: Fight to the death among my followers. Whoever survives will receive my task.
SLAY_CHAMPION: My former champion at Knifepoint Ridge has fallen. Don the Ebony Mail and become my new champion.
CLAIM_REWARD: You are my new champion. The Ebony Mail is yours.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My new champion wears the Ebony Mail as proof of their devotion and victory at Knifepoint Ridge.
The former champion is dead and replaced; treachery and combat have proven this mortal worthy.
I have spoken my final words to my champion for now, but I will watch their deeds with interest.

beats.comment: Player learns of Boethiah's shrine through the book or direct discovery.
Player leads a follower to the Pillar of Sacrifice and slays them.
After the sacrifice, Boethiah commands the cultists to fight to the death.
Boethiah tasks the player with killing her current champion at Knifepoint Ridge.
Player retrieves and equips the Ebony Mail from the fallen champion.
Boethiah names the player her new champion. Quest finishes.
